body:
Adds `research/selection-twin`: exact optimism and regret laws for the argmin of K noisy twin scores, the fixed-budget optimum K, an exact-plant LQ check, and shrinkage / screen-then-verify repairs. Includes the README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok. 9 unit tests pass and `experiments/results.txt` is reproduced by `experiments/run.py`.

Negative or preliminary results are marked in the README: the Gaussian formula understates optimism in the skewed concrete twin, and empirical-Bayes shrinkage barely helps.
